name: Garbage Collector
author: ldnguye4
description:
Humans have destroyed the planet by not recycling properly. Play as aliens to help Mother Nature clean up Earth. 
Instructions:
Move around (WASD/arrows) and pick up items (E/return), then dispose of them in the correct bin, either trash or recycle. However, make sure to rinse out and/or flatten items beforehand if needed! And work together to score more points!
